historical_design_reference.guards: Exact nonnegative integer n, existing global refs limit, nondecreasing total; no per-thread pool, release, reset or new persistent witness index.
historical_design_reference.originals: Calls once outside phases. Return identity and original exception are preserved even if observer rejection occurs.
historical_design_reference.opaque_values: Original record_refs values, record_baselines lists, causal.oracle_guards values and causal_sources original lists keep their actual identities. Copy only exact builtin containers; never deepcopy/copy hooks.
historical_design_reference.aliases: One transient memo per phase preserves frame/active/causal.frame and binding/record_links aliases, without merging distinct opaque physical objects.
historical_design_reference.lifecycle: PRECALL pending call and POSTRETURN/EXCEPTION are distinct phases separated by unlocked original execution. All post-return retained rows/required links/terminal/event are one phase. Whole constructor and frame-stop metadata are combined.
historical_design_reference.finalization: Q16 is charged once per prospective manifest page inside Pages.flush, including rollover, before publication/I/O; no deferred re-charge at finish. Pure page closure and its last page charge precede publication and I/O. Seal prevents later metadata actors; pending writes drain via Condition.wait releasing lock.
historical_design_reference.relocated_fees: Q15 owner-frame memberships move to owner publication; only its +1 marker remains at stop. Q16 total manifest count moves to per-page flush reservations, including rollover; finalization does not charge the same pages again. Exact complete-capture totals preserved, no reset/release.
historical_design_reference.binding: Fresh Reader source checks outside lock; publish checked binding rows/states and charges together, deduplicating identical requested refs; initial callback installed only after initial reservation succeeds.
